# package client

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101/client"
```

Package client is the controlling station of IEC 60870-5-101: it brings up the link, polls the controlled station (unbalanced transmission) or exchanges messages with it (balanced transmission), runs requests (interrogation, counter interrogation, read, commands, clock synchronization, test, reset process, delay acquisition) and delivers monitor-direction ASDUs to a handler.

The link is initialized in the background and re-initialized when the controlled station stops answering, or answers only with frames that cannot answer the message until the last time-out (link.ErrUnexpected wrapping link.ErrTimeout); [Client.WaitUp](#func-client-waitup) waits for it and returns only after Config.OnState for the change to StateUp has returned. Requests fail with [iec101.ErrLinkDown](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101#ErrLinkDown) while the link is down, and return at their context deadline even while the link layer is still repeating their user data. After a failed poll the client waits PollInterval before it polls again.

## Constants

```go
const (
	DefaultPollInterval   = 100 * time.Millisecond
	DefaultRequestTimeout = 10 * time.Second
	DefaultRetryInterval  = 2 * time.Second
	DefaultTestInterval   = 10 * time.Second
	// DefaultMaxResult is the default of Config.MaxResult: an
	// interrogation of 65536 ASDUs, each of one or more objects, is far
	// beyond what a controlled station holds.
	DefaultMaxResult = 65536
)
```

#### func New

```go
func New(rw io.ReadWriter, cfg Config) (*Client, error)
```

New starts a controlling station on rw. Close stops it and closes rw when it is an io.Closer; rw's Close must unblock its Read for Close to return.

#### func (Client) ClockSync

```go
func (c *Client) ClockSync(ctx context.Context, ca asdu.CommonAddr, t time.Time) error
```

ClockSync synchronizes the station's clock (C\_CS\_NA\_1).

#### func (Client) Close

```go
func (c *Client) Close() error
```

Close stops the station and waits for its goroutines. Outstanding requests, and requests made afterwards, fail with [iec101.ErrClosed](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101#ErrClosed). Close is safe to call more than once and from several goroutines: the first call closes the transport and returns its error; later calls return nil.

Called from Config.Handler or Config.OnState on one of the client's goroutines, Close cannot wait for that goroutine: it stops the client and returns nil at once, and the close completes, StateClosed reported included, when the callback has returned.

#### func (Client) Command

```go
func (c *Client) Command(ctx context.Context, ca asdu.CommonAddr, obj asdu.InformationObject) error
```

Command sends a process command and waits for its activation confirmation. For select-before-operate call it twice, first with the object's Select set. A refusal is a [\*telecontrol.NegativeError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/telecontrol#NegativeError).

#### func (Client) Done

```go
func (c *Client) Done() <-chan struct{}
```

Done is closed when the link station stops: after Close, or when the transport fails. Err tells which.

#### func (Client) Err

```go
func (c *Client) Err() error
```

Err returns the error that stopped the station: the transport's, or that of a callback that did not return normally (wrapping [iec101.ErrClosed](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101#ErrClosed)); nil while it runs or after Close.

#### func (Client) Interrogate

```go
func (c *Client) Interrogate(ctx context.Context, ca asdu.CommonAddr, qoi asdu.QOI) ([]*asdu.ASDU, error)
```

Interrogate runs an interrogation (C\_IC\_NA\_1) with qualifier qoi ([asdu.QOIStation](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/asdu#QOIStation) or [asdu.QOIGroup](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/asdu#QOIGroup)) and returns the data the station sent with the matching cause until the activation termination.

More ASDUs than Config.MaxResult end it with an error wrapping [telecontrol.ErrResultLimit](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/telecontrol#ErrResultLimit). Called from the Handler or OnState it returns [iec101.ErrInHandler](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101#ErrInHandler).

#### func (Client) Send

```go
func (c *Client) Send(ctx context.Context, a *asdu.ASDU) error
```

Send transmits a in the control direction without waiting for an application answer. It returns when the link layer confirmed it, or at the deadline of ctx: the client's own goroutine (the poller in unbalanced transmission, the supervisor in balanced) then still finishes the exchange, repeating the frame until it is answered or Link.Retries ran out. Answers reach the Handler.

#### func (Client) SetDelay

```go
func (c *Client) SetDelay(ctx context.Context, ca asdu.CommonAddr, d time.Duration) error
```

SetDelay sends the transmission delay to the station (C\_CD\_NA\_1, cause spontaneous), which corrects following clock synchronizations by it. See [telecontrol.Requester.SetDelay](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/telecontrol#Requester.SetDelay).

#### func (Client) State

```go
func (c *Client) State() iec101.State
```

State returns the link state.

#### func (Client) TestCommand

```go
func (c *Client) TestCommand(ctx context.Context, ca asdu.CommonAddr) error
```

TestCommand sends C\_TS\_NA\_1 with the fixed test bit pattern.

#### func (Client) WaitUp

```go
func (c *Client) WaitUp(ctx context.Context) error
```

WaitUp waits until the link is initialized and OnState has been told (Config.OnState). It returns the transport error when the transport fails first (closed by the peer, say): the client does not reopen a transport, so the link cannot come up on it.

### type Config

```go
type Config struct {
	iec101.Params

	// LinkAddr is the link address of the controlled station. In balanced
	// mode it is the address carried by this station's primary messages.
	LinkAddr uint16
	// OwnAddr is this station's link address in balanced mode.
	OwnAddr uint16

	// PollInterval is the pause between class 2 polls when the controlled
	// station has nothing to send (unbalanced). Zero means
	// [DefaultPollInterval].
	PollInterval time.Duration
	// RequestTimeout bounds every request whose context has no earlier
	// deadline. Zero means [DefaultRequestTimeout].
	RequestTimeout time.Duration
	// RetryInterval is the pause before the link is initialized again
	// after a failure. Zero means [DefaultRetryInterval].
	RetryInterval time.Duration
	// TestInterval is how often an idle balanced link is tested with the
	// test function for link. Zero means [DefaultTestInterval]; negative
	// disables the test.
	TestInterval time.Duration
	// MaxResult bounds the ASDUs one interrogation or counter
	// interrogation collects: the request that would collect more ends
	// with an error wrapping [telecontrol.ErrResultLimit], with the ASDUs
	// so far, instead of growing until its deadline. Zero means
	// [DefaultMaxResult]; negative means no bound, as before v0.6.0.
	MaxResult int

	// Handler receives every monitor-direction ASDU that is not a mirror of
	// a request: spontaneous and cyclic data, and the data that answers an
	// interrogation or read (also returned by those calls). It runs on a
	// goroutine of its own, in order, and the ASDUs wait for it in a queue
	// of 256 (in balanced transmission the link refuses user data, DFC
	// set, while more than half of them wait).
	//
	// The Handler must not wait for the station: while it runs nothing
	// empties the queue, and the answers a request waits for go through
	// it. A request method that waits for an answer (Interrogate,
	// CounterInterrogate, Read, Command, Deactivate, ClockSync,
	// TestCommand, ResetProcess, MeasureDelay) called from the Handler
	// returns [iec101.ErrInHandler] at once. Send and SetDelay wait only
	// for the link layer; in unbalanced transmission that is the poller,
	// which waits for room in the queue, so they too are best made from
	// another goroutine. The Handler may call Close, which then does not
	// wait for the Handler's goroutine: it returns at once, the Handler is
	// not called again, and the client completes the close when the
	// Handler has returned. A Handler that does not return normally is
	// logged with its stack and closes the client; Err reports it.
	Handler func(a *asdu.ASDU)
	// OnState is called with each change of the link state, from the
	// goroutine that changed it: one of the client's own goroutines, or
	// Close. WaitUp returns only after OnState for the change to StateUp
	// has returned, so what the callback sets up is in place when WaitUp
	// returns. State reports a change before OnState for it is called.
	// Called on one of the client's goroutines, OnState cannot have a
	// request answered: the request methods, Send and SetDelay return
	// [iec101.ErrInHandler]; start them in a new goroutine. It may call
	// Close, as the Handler may. An OnState that does not return normally
	// is logged and closes the client, as for the Handler.
	OnState func(s iec101.State, err error)
	// Logger receives the log entries; nil is silent.
	Logger iec60870.Logger
}
```

Config configures a client.
